title: Refine CI failure classifier and compactify toolchain bootstrap
author: Aisha Kapoor
ci_status: pass (one flaky unit test retried once)
release_notes: Improve CI failure triage to reduce noisy pagering; shrink dev toolchain bootstrap images and split out language-specific steps for faster presubmit; no runtime behavior changes.
body:
Context: Our presubmit CI has been generating a lot of noisy failures that mask real regressions. Two common sources were: (1) noisy infra flakiness (network/timeouts) being surfaced as 'build' failures and (2) large toolchain bootstraps that make warm-up slow and increase presubmit latency. This PR implements a pragmatic two-part change: a) a CI failure classifier that annotates and groups flakes vs. deterministic failures so alerts and presubmit policies can be more tactical; and b) compactify the toolchain bootstrap by splitting language/tool-specific steps into separate cached stages and introducing a minimal dev image for the majority of lint/test jobs. The description below is a single continuous narrative with the motivation, high-level changes, and review highlights. Motivation: reduce developer context-switching from noisy CI failures and speed up presubmit feedback loops so PR authors get actionable signals faster. Related: ENG-1328 (presubmit noise reduction), ENG-1402 (toolchain cost/latency optimizations). What this PR does (high-level): - Introduces a CI failure-classifier module (ci/tools/failure_classifier.py + small TS shim) that inspects job logs, exit codes and common transient patterns (network io, grpc timeouts, flaky test markers) and emits an annotation to the PR check summary. - Adds annotations to GitHub check output and to our in-house CI telemetry so failures can be grouped in dashboards (new tag: failure_class). - Refactors .github/workflows/presubmit.yml: splits bootstrap into three cached stages (base-image-prepare, language-install, runtime-verify) and wires selective cache invalidation to avoid redoing installs when only source changes. - Adds a minimal dev toolchain image (docker/dev-minimal:2026-01) with only node/python/rust runtimes + package managers to run linters and fast unit tests; heavier integration tests use the full image. - Adds a heuristic in the presubmit runner that automatically retries suspected-transient failures (1 retry) and marks them as 'flake' instead of 'hard-fail' when classifier confidence > 0.7. - Includes lightweight telemetry counters and a Grafana dashboard annotation (infra team will enable).
Commits summary: 6 commits. Key messages: initial classifier prototype; add GH check annotation; split presubmit bootstrap stages and cache keys; minimal dev image Dockerfile + publish job; documentation + test harness for classifier; cleanup and tests. Files changed (high-level): ["ci/tools/failure_classifier.py", ".github/workflows/presubmit.yml", "docker/dev-minimal/Dockerfile", "ci/publish_dev_images.yml", "ci/telemetry/mappings.yml", "scripts/presubmit_runner.sh", "docs/ci_failure_classification.md", "tests/ci/test_classifier_unit.py", "tools/ts/check-annotator.ts", "package.json", "Makefile", "infra/cache-keying.md"]

Review & discussion highlights: - Liam: requested stronger evidence that classifier won't hide real regressions; asked for a conservative default (classify-only on first rollout). Author response: added confidence threshold and opt-in flag in the workflow (env CI_CLASSIFY=true for rollout). - Sofia: requested cache key scheme docs and a small e2e validating that language installs are skipped when lockfile unchanged. Author: added infra/cache-keying.md and a small e2e in tests/ci/. - Diego: asked to avoid automatic retries for flake patterns that historically correlate with real regressions. Author: limited retry scope to networking and external service timeouts; excluded test-exit-code-specific retries. - Security review (brief): confirmed minimal dev image uses upstream pinned base and non-root build user. - QA: added a harness to replay historical CI logs to verify classifier precision/recall on a sampled window. CI behavior and runs: - Initial CI run: failed one integration that depended on external service; classifier flagged as transient, retried job automatically and passed on retry. - One unit test (tests/ci/test_classifier_unit.py::test_edge_pattern) was flaky in the first run; retried and passed; CI status then green. - Full presubmit matrix runs showed ~22% median reduction in bootstrap wall time for lint/unit lanes due to the minimal image and cache separation.
Rollout & migration plan: - Feature gated behind CI_CLASSIFY flag; enabled for all internal repositories for 1 week, telemetry monitored. - If classifier shows >4% false-negative (missed real failure) rate, it will be disabled automatically via circuit-breaker. - Min dev image will be published to internal registry and legacy jobs will be gradually switched to it over 2 sprints.
Merge notes: - Squash-merged to main after approvals from Liam and Sofia and green CI. - No runtime code path changes; purely CI/tooling/infra. - Post-merge: infra will add the new Grafana panels and enable the classifier flag via org-level workflow config.
Cherry-picks/backout plan: - Backout via revert PR if classifier misclassifies production-impacting CI signals. - Image publish job has an explicit tag retention policy to rollback easily. Links: Linear ENG-1328, ENG-1402; docs/ci_failure_classification.md; telemetry ticket ENG-1450 for dashboard setup. Checklist: [x] Tests added for classifier heuristics [x] Docs updated [x] Minimal dev image built and smoke-tested [x] Infra/telemetry hooks added
commits_summary: 6 commits: prototype classifier, GH annotation + telemetry, presubmit bootstrap split, dev-minimal image and publish job, e2e tests and docs, cleanup/tests.
review_comments: Liam Chen: please add conservative rollout + confidence threshold so we don't hide regressions. - addressed with CI_CLASSIFY flag and default conservative threshold.
Sofia Müller: can you document cache key derivation? - added infra/cache-keying.md and e2e to validate behavior.
Diego Alvarez: avoid retries for tests that historically indicate real regressions. - limited retry scope to networking/service-timeouts only.
Infra: ensure image uses pinned bases and non-root user. - confirmed and added security note in docs.
QA: replayed 500 historical logs; classifier precision ~0.83 recall ~0.79 on sampled window.
merge_outcome: squash merged by Aisha Kapoor after approvals and green CI
